name: Wildcat 3 - Z 1 Right - 38 Sweep

TB.rule: Take the snap, drop a step and swing right behind the fullback -- he goes first. Stay behind him until his block is made, then turn it up outside it.

QB.note: You are a wing on this play, not the quarterback -- you line up beside the Z, a step outside him, and you take the outside man. You do not touch the ball.

coaching_points: Wildcat 3 is the tailback at the snap, five yards back. Rep the snap before you rep the play -- a bad snap is the only way this loses yards.
The fullback loads the edge: he goes first, right, and doubles the outside linebacker with the Z. The tailback stays behind them until the block is made.
The quarterback is a wing beside the Z. He does not touch the ball -- tell him before the snap, and tell the defense nothing.
